summary: 52-year-old male climbing with a group on the Boulderado formation suffered a medical emergency (went limp, seizure-like activity) after clipping into the top anchor; the group lowered him to the ground; Nederland Fire Protection District and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group assisted, American Medical Response evaluated him and transported him to a local hospital. BCSO case #21-4326.
notes: Boulder County news release, September 8, 2021; incident about 10:30 a.m. Inserted run 1015 (Boulder Weekly chunk).
